gaps.explanation: 'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: She works in ___ insurance, not banking.
gaps.explanation: Industry/sector names take no article: in insurance, in banking, in marketing.

gaps.sentence: The novel had a huge effect on ___ young people of the 1960s.
gaps.explanation: 'The young people of the 1960s' — defined by the of-phrase, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: He was wearing ___ strange metal bracelet on his left wrist.
gaps.explanation: 'A strange bracelet' (first mention); body parts after prepositions traditionally take 'the' (on the left wrist).

gaps.sentence: ___ disabled are offered free entry on Sundays.
gaps.explanation: 'The disabled' = disabled people as a group.

gaps.sentence: She earns fifty pounds ___ hour as a consultant.
gaps.explanation: 'An hour' — the 'h' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound.
